qAndA.question: What does the man use as a visual aid to explain crystal structure?

qAndA.answer: Edge Dislocation is a line defect.
qAndA.question: What type of defect is Edge Dislocation?

qAndA.answer: He uses dots to represent atoms.
qAndA.question: How does the man represent atoms in his diagram?

qAndA.answer: It causes the shape of the crystal to distort, creating an Edge Dislocation.
qAndA.question: What happens when an extra half-plane is inserted into a crystal?

qAndA.answer: Positive Edge Dislocation occurs when the extra half-plane is inserted from the top. Negative Edge Dislocation occurs when it's inserted from the bottom.
qAndA.question: What is the difference between positive and negative edge dislocation?

#EdgeDislocation #Linedefect

Line Defect is one a very prominent defect found in crystals.. And Edge Defect is a type of line defect which happens when an extra half plane is inserted in one edge of the crystal..
